info.title: API.SH: MarketWatch
info.description: The MarketWatch API from API.SH: public MarketWatch data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Analyst snapshot (average recommendation, target price, number of ratings), price targets (high, median, low, average), yearly and quarterly EPS estimates with actuals and surprises, rating counts over time, upgrades and downgrades and EPS estimate trends.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marketwatch-analyst-estimates

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker, a Dow Jones id like `Stock-US-AAPL`, or a marketwatch.com quote link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter market country (default `US`; `UK` for London, `JP` for Tokyo, `BX` for bonds).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
OHLC and volume bars for a timeframe and step: intraday (1 to 60 minutes over 1, 5 or 10 days) or daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly bars up to the full history.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marketwatch-history

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker, a Dow Jones id like `Stock-US-AAPL`, or a marketwatch.com quote link.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Instrument type (default `stock`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter market country (default `US`; `UK` for London, `JP` for Tokyo, `BX` for bonds).

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Time span (default `P1Y`).

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Bar size (default depends on the timeframe). Intraday steps need D1-D10; ALL and P10Y need P7D or longer.

parameters.name: extended
parameters.description: Include pre-market and after-hours bars (intraday).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Quote for a stock, fund, index, future, currency, crypto or bond: last price and time, open, high, low, change, volume, previous close, pre-market and after-hours, market cap, shares outstanding, P/E, EPS, dividend, yield, 50/200-day moving averages, closes 1 week to 3 years ago, price ranges with dates, sector and industry, ISIN/CUSIP/SEDOL, exchange and delay, and company info (address, phone, website, employees). `symbols` takes up to 25 (`type:SYMBOL` for non-stocks, e.g. `index:COMP`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marketwatch-quote

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker (or use `symbols`).

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Up to 25, comma separated, e.g. `AAPL,index:COMP,crypto:BTCUSD`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Instrument type (default `stock`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter market country (default `US`; `UK` for London, `JP` for Tokyo, `BX` for bonds).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Symbol search across stocks, funds, indexes, futures, currencies and crypto worldwide: ticker, name, type, country, exchange and quote link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/marketwatch-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text, e.g. `tesla`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results (default 12, max 50).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Preferred market country (default `US`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
